title: Playboy Magazine December 1992 Gala Christmas Sharon Stone Basic Instinct
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, spine wear or address label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1992 - Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $5.95.

Features:
- Sharon Stone shows her Basic Instincts in a bombshell Playboy Interview
- The new Jessica Hahn
- Sex in Space by Arthur C. Clarke
- A holiday treat from Joyce Carol Oates
- Legendary pinup Betty Page
- Penn and Teller get very strange
- Sex Stars of 1992; fiction by Donald E. Westlake and Thomas Berger
- Helmut Newton in a wicked 20 Questions
- Playboy's College Basketball Preview

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
